admission.justification: Module-boundary reset, an exact treatment register and private test-created machine resources protect different collision paths. The joint guarantee concerns surviving imported product owners and tmux isolation, not restoration of removed ambient or provider state.

guarantee: The remaining Python suite brackets modules by resetting already-imported scanner-visible mutable product owners and explicitly resetting the relocated kernel worktree-service binding holder, whose object state is outside the module-collection census. It enforces the closed source-state treatment register and gives each process a private test-created tmux server with owned cleanup. Together these prevent retained process state, service suppliers and tmux-resource collisions from depending on module order or another pytest process. Removed ambient/lifecycle owners and removed local Eve provider-process/socket guarantees remain outside the current member obligation.
title: Test processes isolate mutable owners and machine resources
